title: MemorySpacesListResponse
description: Success payload for memory.spaces.list (§7.2). Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.spaces.list (§7.2): No page-specific codes are documented; pagination invalidation uses CURSOR_INVALID (§7.0.7).. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.

spaces.description: Spaces visible to the principal; each entry includes the computed pending_receipts.

error.description: Memory error envelope: shared ErrorEnvelope plus required details.retry_class (§14.1–14.2).
